title_o: Multiple roles for time in short-term memory: Evidence from serial recall of order and timing.
verdict_reason: Raw csv (40 subjects x 80 trials) reproduces the report's key test exactly: paired t on 4th-latency deviation from a quadratic fit, timing task, t(39)=2.08, p=.0438, d=.367 (table .044/.37). Caution: the RPP audit script computes a different test (index x grouped F, p=.0295).
